posts.title: Bishop and Knight Mate — the Missing Part
Change Grundfos PM 2 Pressure Monitor Cable
posts.description: The Grundfos PM 2 pressure control unit is used to automatically switch water pumps on and off. The electrical connection to the pump is made using a Schuko (type F) plug connection. In my case, this connection had burned out and I had to replace it. This blog post describes how to do it.

posts.title: Yargs 18 Pitfalls
posts.description: Upgrading Yargs from version 17 to 18 in a TypeScript project using Jest turned out to be a bit of a nightmare. The release notes for Yargs 18.0.0 include the line “yargs is now ESM first” — a seemingly small change that can cause major headaches. In this blog post, we’ll take a closer look at what that means and how to deal with it.
